notes.title: CROSS PROMOTION!
notes.notes:
[b]ABOUT RERUNNER:[/b]

BIT.TRIP RERUNNER is a captivating rhythm platformer that transports players into a mesmerizing world of retro-style graphics and infectious beats. Players control Commandervideo, navigating through levels filled with obstacles, synchronized perfectly to the pulsating rhythm of the music. Each jump, slide, and dodge must be timed precisely to the beat, creating a seamless fusion of gameplay and music that keeps players immersed in the experience. With its addictive gameplay, stylish visuals, and toe-tapping soundtrack, BIT.TRIP RERUNNER offers an exhilarating journey for players looking for a unique and engaging gaming experience.

[b]+RUNNER MAKER & +MUSIC MAKER[/b]

BIT.TRIP RERUNNER's innovative features extend beyond its captivating gameplay to include the dynamic +RUNNER MAKER and +MUSIC MAKER tools. With +RUNNER MAKER, players step into the role of game designers, empowered to craft their own levels filled with challenges and obstacles. This creative freedom allows players to personalize their gaming experience and share their creations with the vibrant community, fostering an endless array of unique and exciting levels. The +MUSIC MAKER enables the player to customize the game's soundtrack. With this tool, players can create and integrate their own music compositions into the game, further enhancing the immersive experience and adding a personal touch to their gameplay journey. Together, these innovative tools not only enhance player creativity but also foster a sense of community and collaboration within the BIT.TRIP RERUNNER universe!

[b]But how crazy is it? (It's fairly crazy)[/b]

notes.title: Humble Bundle for Android (and PC, Mac, and Linux) launches
notes.notes:
The Humble Bundle is back on, this time offering a set of games for Android devices. It includes Fieldrunners, Bit.Trip Beat, SpaceChem, and Uplink. Paying more than the average (currently just over $6) gets you Spirits as well.

SpaceChem and Uplink will both require a tablet, if you're playing the Android versions, but the good news is that a single purchase unlocks Windows, Mac, and Linux versions as well. All of the games also come with soundtracks, so altogether Humble Bundle touts a $52 value. As usual, you'll be able to name your own price.

To get the latest Humble Bundle, visit the website.

notes.title: Bit.Trip Runner's Sequel Just Keeps on Running
notes.notes:
The ridiculously good Bit.Trip Runner has a sequel, of sorts, on the way. It's not part of the Bit.Trip series, though, so it's simply called Runner 2. Which about sums up what's going on.

Note that, as good as this already looks, it's a "super sneaky peek" at pre-alpha code, which you'll eventually realise with the lack of effects or background animations.

Trailer: Runner 2 Pre-Alpha Footage (Gaijin Games) [IndieGames]

notes.title: Next Humble Bundle Leaks, Is A Goodun
notes.notes:
Details of the next Humble Indie Bundle have once more leaked, because Steam’s Content Description Record Viewer Thingamie is so ludicrously easy for people to spy. And it looks like it’s going to be a bit of a corker, as spotted by DIY Gamer. In the pay-what-you-want collection it seems there will be Super Meat Boy, BIT.TRIP.RUNNER, Jamestown, Nightsky and Shank. That’s the first wave, and then there’s even better to get added in.

notes.title: Bit.Trip Complete retail collection coming to Wii
notes.notes:
As well as being collected and 3D-itised for Nintendo 3DS in Bit.Trip Saga, Gaijin's whole retro-styled rhythm game series Bit.Trip bit is coming to retail shelves for Wii with new content in Bit.Trip Complete.

Bit.Trip Beat and Bit.Trip Runner

Along with the six Bit.Trip games released on WiiWare--Beat, Core, Void, Runner, Fate, and Flux--the Bit.Trip Complete collection will add new content and include bonus goodies. All six are getting new difficulty modes, online leaderboards, and challenges--120 in total.

On top of that, you'll get a soundtrack CD with tunes from across the series, an audio gallery with "fan remixes, original songs, and demo versions of existing Bit.Trip themes," a video gallery with production stills and concept art, a video gallery, and more.

Bit.Trip Complete is headed to Wii this summer alongside Bit.Trip Saga. Aksys Games is publishing them both.

notes.title: Now Available - BIT.TRIP RUNNER
notes.notes:
BIT.TRIP RUNNER -- the fastest, most exhilarating music/rhythm-platformer, is now available on Steam! Following the release of BIT.TRIP BEAT, RUNNER is the latest chapter on Steam and one of the most popular edition in the award-winning BIT.TRIP series.

To celebrate its finalist nomination at the 2011 Independent Game Festival, RUNNER will be available at a 10% discount now through March 7th, 10AM PST.

Race across the Moon, kicking down crystal walls and sliding under chomping moon-slugs! Bound through the Robotic Mines and face off against the MinerMech! Dash through the Big City on a quest to find friends and defeat the final boss together!
